beats.say: 4 billion miles: Leo picked up a faint radio broadcast.
Quickplay Daily says while scanning an alien planet, his speaker played 80s synth-pop.
He tuned his receiver to trace the retro beat across the dark crater.
The music suddenly cut out, replaced by a sharp audio beep.
A familiar voice left a strange message for tomorrow morning.
The broadcast was a voicemail from his own spacesuit, sent three days in the future.
That was Quickplay Facts; subscribe so you don't miss the next one. Would you answer a call from the future?
